user.title: Standalone SmartPI calculator
user.description: Only calculates a heating demand, 0–100%. Never controls devices. Learning starts disabled until you confirm external 1:1 application in Options.

init.title: Sources and learning
init.description: Enable learning only when the published demand is actually applied externally 1:1. Boiler outages and external suppression are not detected. There is no pump-overrun protection.
